sample_dataframe: sample a DataFrame by overlap bins distributing quota evenly across bins with leftover carryover
build_training_sample: build a training sample from a DataFrame row with camera extrinsics and movement question templates
convert_train_sample_to_eval_sample: convert a training sample with conversations to an evaluation sample with text field

build_val_dataset: build a validation dataset from a parquet file sampling rows and converting to eval format
